description:
Try historytime.io for the daily timeline challenge! https://hystorytime.io

In this video we go through even more ancient technology, from heated floors in the Roman Empire, to Al Jazari's Elephant Clock, the Wine Pouring Robot, the first Earthquake detector (Zhang Heng's Seismometer) and of course the Assasin's Teapot.
